description: Export the solution (unmanaged and optionally managed), unpack it to <targetDir>/src, write <targetDir>/solution.json, generate deployment-settings.json (connection references + environment variables to map), and clone every agent in the solution into <targetDir>/agents/<name> as a sync-connected workspace. This is the input for cs_deploy_solution.

background.description: Run in the background and return a jobId immediately. Use this when the export is large enough that the MCP client times the call out; poll with cs_job_status.

environment.description: Environment id or URL. Defaults to the active pac auth profile.

packagetype.description: Default Both: exports both zips, unpacks both

name: cs_pull_solution
title: Pull a whole solution locally
